executive_summary: mathematical-statistics-foundations-37 stands at publishable-pending-owner-approval. The packet shows a single-category build of 74 pages and 486 items whose two proof-layout gates pass across 1,404 steps, complete and exact judge coverage for the configured set at the frozen context, a closed judge-closure with zero workflow-owned blockers and empty deferral lists; only owner-side actions remain - the personal mathematical audit, the deliberate status:published change, and push/deployment. This reading of the packet treats the mathematical layer as closed for the frozen hash, and it is not itself a re-verification of the items. The run's defect history reads mostly as resolved churn: all but one of the 55 fatal-class rows carry a fixed or superseded-by-fixed disposition, and all rejected judge verdicts were adjudicated (20 confirmed fatal, 47 confirmed nonfatal, 11 false positives). Two threads stay visible for the audit: one published theorem row still labelled deferred on an ambient measure-space binding whose recorded local correction explicitly disclaims independent acceptance, and the run's final repair wave, whose six configured-set rejections (three delta-method examples, the lasso theorem, a uniform-CDF example, a continuity counterexample) were adjudicated with post-verdict text changes that carry no later configured-set read. Citation fidelity is the broadest residual class, and the personal audit remains the only independent mathematical cross-check before publication.
caveats: The packet's fatal table contains a single row without a fixed or superseded disposition: msf37-b34-published-zero-integral-ambient, whose note says the ambient measure-space binding of the published theorem thm-nonnegative-integral-zero-iff-zero-almost-everywhere is 'deferred, not fixed' with the owner repair pending. The repository shows that repair was later recorded locally (content SHA-256 4dd935ed280078ddaec0cefeb4b6ddec680e1996b3aee2ddd447bc5c01bd6a22, precheck and rendercheck passing), and the recorded local repair entry states it is not a whole-item audit or independent mathematical acceptance, so the label and the correction need one owner read to reconcile.

Judge coverage of the final repair wave is selective rather than fresh: the configured set rejected six item versions (ex-log-transformation-delta-method, ex-second-order-delta-method-quadratic, ex-ratio-delta-method, ex-uniform-empirical-cdf-converges-to-brownian-bridge, thm-lasso-prediction-and-l1-error-under-incoherence, cex-continuity-alone-does-not-give-delta-method). For five of the six the verdict's recorded item hash no longer matches the current item bytes and the packet's judge ledger holds no later configured-set row, so the repaired text is closed by adjudication notes and repair records rather than by a second configured-set read; the sixth was dismissed as a false positive on unchanged text.

Judge coverage is complete and exact against the frozen context, but it is one configured process with no independent second judge read of the repaired text: the six rejections above end with no later verdict on the changed bytes. Any edit made after the audit - including a hand edit during the status flip - invalidates the stored evidence for the changed items, so findings must route back through the engine rather than being patched directly.

The packet's repeated-repairs section is empty even though the fatal table names step5-repeat-r1 rows and several items changed after their last configured-set verdict; read that section as 'no defect row was tagged as a recurrence', not as 'no item was repaired more than once', and use the defect rows themselves to identify the re-touched items.

Two batch-13 published-reader citation findings were fixed inline - the usual-metric F10 substitution to lem-real-line-is-a-metric-space in ex-nonidentifiable-targets-preclude-consistency and the F14 replacement in thm-iid-sample-mean-consistency - and the first row's note states the finding was risk-only with no owed decision and that owner/engine must still route it; the text fix is recorded, but the routing itself is a governance step to confirm before publication.

Citation accuracy is the dominant fatal subclass in the packet (21 citation-inaccurate rows plus one citation-inflated, concentrated in fact blocks, frontmatter and sources), and it is the class that mechanical layout gates cannot see and a frozen-context judge does not guarantee a re-read of the cited works; only reading the exact cited statements in their sources settles it.
